headline: Football GM now has an evidence-backed INP mitigation and S262's closeout proof is recovered.

items.title: Football GM INP presentation mitigation shipped
items.insight: Football GM was the field-data hotspot, and the page now spends less paint/compositing work around the hero, feature cards, and below-fold regions. The claim stays honest: this is a shipped mitigation that still needs post-deploy field soak before it becomes a win.

items.title: RUM and Trusted Types evidence refreshed
items.insight: The public evidence layer now reflects the latest R2 telemetry instead of stale assumptions. TT remains AMBER because live reports are nonzero, while the active-local manifest shows no still-present local HTML sink.

items.title: Atlas owner handoff shipped via Ark
items.insight: Atlas freshness is owned outside this repo, so S262 used Ark instead of touching a sibling tree. That keeps the website honest while still moving the owner thread forward.

items.title: Interrupted closeout recovered and verified
items.insight: The recovery found a real generated-drift failure before it could be committed as phantom-green. After regenerating the dependent public artifacts, build-check and doctor both pass with direct evidence.
items.evidence: npm run build EXIT 0; npm run build:check EXIT 0 (171/171); node scripts/run-doctor.mjs --json blockingFailing=0

followUps: Verify remote CI/deploy for the recovered S262 commit after push.
Rerun RUM after field soak and compare Football GM INP against the mitigation.
Keep play-next untouched until true-viewport impressions exist.
blockers: TT enforcement remains gated on near-zero fresh live soak plus founder-device verification.
Full Obelisk provider/data-plane flip remains gated on missing obelisk.identity.verify RP keys.
Forge devlog publication remains founder-voice gated.
